regime_context: Momentum ranks for Hong Kong show a narrow, non-directional regime: only 4 of 17 themes are trend-eligible, Banks (H + HK) are the crowded leader but the theme is mean-reverting (hurst_tag), with no validated basket-drawdown edge from the gate. Since trend discipline was validated as drawdown control on this market historically, eligible themes are the honest opportunity set, but all eligible themes here lack scorable ETF proxies, so conviction must stay low.
